Scope: Static publisher-page, version, licensing, dependency and data-effect review of MiTeC Interbase Query and Paradox Data Editor; no payload executed and no database opened

TermsPage.Observation: The current support EULA says trial/unregistered software is freeware for non-commercial use and lists named-user/build-machine, team, site and trial licensing. Local intended-use entitlement and redistribution remain unresolved.

Products.Name: MiTeC Interbase Query
Products.PublishedBehavior: Manages InterBase 6+/Firebird 1.5+ databases using IBX components. SQL editor can run any statement/script and saves successful statements in history. Object explorer edits some objects and extracts metadata including table data. User/role add-edit-delete and grant/revoke managers are available. Services include log/properties/statistics, validation, shutdown, online and offline. Registered version adds CSV/XML/raw-batch/printer import/export, index rebuild, event watcher, performance monitor and codebase.
Products.LicensePagePriceObservation: The page lists EUR 99 single-user, EUR 299 team and EUR 799 site lifetime licenses on the review date. These page prices and the support EULA do not establish local entitlement or redistribution.
Products.DependencyGate: The publisher identifies IBX components and an optional client DLL path; exact runtime/client version, architecture matching, and redistribution notices remain unverified.
Products.Acceptance: Use only a disposable synthetic InterBase/Firebird database and service. Do not run arbitrary SQL against real data; do not change real users/roles/privileges, shutdown or toggle a live database, or export production rows. Verify transaction/backup and exact restoration for any synthetic mutation.

Products.Name: MiTeC Paradox Data Editor
Products.PublishedBehavior: Views/edits Paradox tables; can remove password protection, repair tables, view BLOBs, filter/search, manage indexes/structure, convert table levels 4/5/7, export to HTML/SYLK/Excel/RTF/XML/CSV and import XML/CSV. Uses BDE; page history says startup update checks were added in 3.6.0.
Products.LicensePagePriceObservation: The page lists a EUR 30 single-user lifetime license on the review date. The support EULA and local entitlement/redistribution assessment remain separate.
Products.InstallerOuterMetadata: x86 PE; publisher version resource fields blank; copyright says 2001-2023. Prior bounded listing has 18 entries, but payload/actions remain opaque and unexecuted.
Products.DependencyGate: BDE is required. Exact BDE version/provider/bitness, installer changes, registration/coexistence and redistribution rights remain unverified.
Products.Acceptance: Use disposable copies of synthetic Paradox tables with known BDE/provider state; test edits, password/repair/conversion/import/export, byte-exact originals and recovery. Never apply password removal/repair to real user data.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Publisher versions/features, separate x86/x64 Interbase Query files, BDE dependency, opaque Paradox installer pin and published license choices are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Local entitlements, IBX/client and BDE component provenance/bitness/redistribution, installer actions, database mutation/repair, credentials, UI and activation remain unverified.
Deferred: Owner-specific MiTeC use and distribution assessment for both tools
Do not test against live InterBase/Firebird services or non-synthetic databases
No Paradox installer/BDE registration until exact dependency, coexistence, terms and rollback are established
Any future acceptance must use synthetic disposable database copies and verify exact recovery
